invoices_discount_over_subtotal: A discount cannot exceed the subtotal.
invoices_discount_over_line: A discount cannot exceed the line's amount.
invoices_number_date_month: Year and month, count restarts each month
invoices_number_date_day: Full date, count restarts each day
invoices_statement_account_not_found: That account does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
invoices_statement_bad_period: Those dates do not make a period.
invoices_not_found: That invoice does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
invoices_recurring_custom_days_required: A custom frequency needs an interval in days.
invoices_recurring_auto_send_needs_line: Add at least one line before turning on auto-send.
invoices_estimate_convert_failed: Could not raise an invoice from this estimate.
invoices_estimate_form_unreadable: The estimate form could not be read. Please try again.
invoices_lines_required: Add at least one line with a description and an amount.
invoices_form_unreadable: The invoice form could not be read. Please try again.
invoices_product_price_invalid: Enter a list price of 0 or more.
invoices_product_change_admin_only: Only an administrator can change products.
invoices_product_delete_admin_only: Only an administrator can delete products.
invoices_product_add_admin_only: Only an administrator can add products.
invoices_recurring_form_unreadable: The schedule form could not be read. Please try again.
invoices_template_change_admin_only: Only an administrator can change invoice templates.
invoices_template_default_failed: Could not change the default template.
invoices_template_create_admin_only: Only an admin can create an invoice template.
invoices_empty_body_deals: Invoices show up here once you raise one. A won deal is usually the place to start. The amount and the account are already there.
invoices_empty_body: Invoices show up here once you raise one.
invoices_never_sent: This invoice has never been sent.
invoices_no_lines: No line items on this invoice.
invoices_record_payment_hint: Leave the amount blank to settle the full {balance} balance.
invoices_filtered_note: These numbers describe the filtered list.
invoices_estimates_stat_accepted_detail: Agreed and waiting on an invoice
invoices_estimates_meta: Accepted but unbilled first, then most recently sent
invoices_estimates_empty_body_deals: An estimate is a priced proposal you can turn into an invoice once the customer accepts it. Most start from a deal that already has the amount and the account.
invoices_estimates_empty_body: An estimate is a priced proposal you can turn into an invoice once the customer accepts it.
invoices_estimate_new_sub: Nothing is sent until you send it. Saving leaves it as a draft
invoices_estimate_dates_backwards: The estimate cannot expire before it is issued.
invoices_form_tax_hint: Tax applies to the subtotal after the discount.
invoices_form_preview_empty: Add a line with a description and an amount, and the customer's copy appears here.
invoices_estimate_customer_link_hint: Generated, and only sent when you send the estimate
invoices_custom_terms_fallback: Custom terms with no date set becomes {terms} on save, the server falls back to 30 days rather than leaving the date empty.
invoices_form_tax_shipping_hint: Tax applies to the subtotal after the discount. Shipping is added afterwards and is not taxed.
invoices_due_from_terms: {terms} from the issue date. The server recalculates this on save from the same two fields.
invoices_due_needs_issue_date: Set an issue date to see the due date.
invoices_customer_link_hint: Generated, and only sent when you send the invoice
invoices_assigned_hint: Both come from the server so that two people saving at once cannot collide.
invoices_recurring_new_sub: Nothing generates until the first run date arrives. Saving creates the schedule
invoices_recurring_auto_send_hint: off leaves a draft for you to review and send
invoices_recurring_tax_hint: Tax applies to the subtotal after the discount, on every invoice raised.
invoices_recurring_preview_empty: Lines are optional here unless each invoice is sent automatically. Add one to preview what each generated invoice will total, or save the schedule without pricing it yet.
invoices_recurring_subtotal_total_hint: Recalculated by the server on every save and every generated invoice
invoices_recurring_visibility_hint: Any signed-in teammate may create one. After that only the creator, an assignee, or an admin can see or change it, and this form has no way to add an assignee, so only you and an admin will see this schedule
invoices_recurring_stat_rate_detail: Every active schedule, normalised to a month
invoices_recurring_stat_soon_detail: Drafts to check before they send
invoices_recurring_meta: Active first, then soonest to generate
invoices_recurring_empty_body: A recurring invoice is a template plus a cadence. Set one up for anything you bill on the same day every month and stop retyping it.
invoices_products_empty_body: Add the things you sell and their list prices. Line items on invoices and estimates pick from here, so the price is right without anyone remembering it.
invoices_products_ask_admin: Ask an admin to add products.
invoices_products_retired_note: Retired products stay listed because they appear on invoices already issued. Removing one would change what those invoices say was sold.
invoices_products_sellable_option: Sellable, appears in the line-item picker
invoices_products_retired_option: Retired, kept for history, hidden from the picker
invoices_products_add_admin_note: The product catalogue is shared across the org, so only an administrator can add to it. You can still use any product on your invoices and estimates.
invoices_products_category_hint: Category groups the catalogue; leave it blank and the product sits under "Uncategorised". A SKU is optional but must be unique here if you set one.
invoices_products_description_placeholde: What it is, in the words a client would see on an invoice.
invoices_products_change_admin_note: The product catalogue is shared across the org, so only an administrator can change it.

match.countPlural=one: On {shown} invoice already. Retiring keeps those intact.
match.countPlural=other: On {shown} invoices already. Retiring keeps those intact.

invoices_products_delete_used_hint: This product is on invoices already. Prefer Retire above.
invoices_products_delete_unused_hint: Never invoiced, so it is safe to remove.
invoices_templates_sub_default: {count} templates · {name} is used for new invoices
invoices_templates_no_default: No template is the default, so new invoices print with the built-in layout.
invoices_templates_custom_flag: Replaces the whole document with {size} kB of custom markup, including the line-item table and the totals. Nothing checks that it still prints an amount due.

match.countPlural=one: {shown} template has never been used and is not the default, deleting it changes no existing invoice.
match.countPlural=other: {shown} templates have never been used and are not the default, deleting them changes no existing invoice.

invoices_templates_no_preview_title: Custom markup is not previewed here
invoices_templates_no_preview_body: A template's HTML and CSS are rendered into a PDF on the server, never into this page. The only way to see a custom layout is to generate a document from it, which is also the only way to see what a customer will actually receive.
invoices_templates_create_admin_note: Invoice templates are shared config for the whole org, every invoice's look, so only an administrator can create one. You can still see how existing templates look on the templates page.
invoices_templates_colour_hint: Picked, not typed, so the value sent is always a valid six digit hex.
invoices_templates_make_default_hint: Only one template can be the default at a time. Turning this on replaces whichever template holds it now, new invoices will print with this one instead.
invoices_templates_change_admin_note: A template decides how every invoice in the org prints, so only an administrator can change one. You can still see the catalogue on the templates page.
invoices_templates_custom_layout_note: Filling these in replaces the whole printed document, the line-item table and the totals included. Nothing checks that what you write still prints an amount due. Leave both empty to use the built-in layout. Emptying a field that has markup in it now clears it.
invoices_templates_is_default_note: This is the org default, so these changes apply to every new invoice. Which template is the default is changed from the templates page, not here.
invoices_reports_locked_body: Invoiced and collected totals, revenue by month and accounts-receivable aging cover the whole organisation's money, so they are limited to admins. Your own invoices and estimates are on these tabs:
invoices_reports_by_month_note: Each is counted in the month it happened, so they do not line up: the gap in the most recent month is earlier invoices still being paid, not a drop in sales.
invoices_reports_aging_title: How late the overdue money is
invoices_reports_not_yet_due_note: across {count} invoices, not late, not shown above
invoices_reports_who_owes_note: These {count} accounts are the whole overdue balance, not the top few of a longer list.
